PublicRemarks: Great opportunity in Charlotte's growing Oakdale area! Whether you're looking for a place to call home or an investor seeking to add to your portfolio, 2412 Smugglers Court offers plenty of potential. The property has been consistently tenant-occupied since the current owner purchased it in 2008 and has never been owner-occupied, demonstrating its long-standing appeal as a rental while offering a new owner the opportunity to make it their own. Major updates include the HVAC system, water heater, and dishwasher, all replaced in 2019. The surrounding Oakdale area continues to see reinvestment, with newer construction and renovated homes nearby contributing to the neighborhood's evolving character and appeal. Conveniently located with access to shopping, dining, employment centers, and major thoroughfares, this property is well positioned to enjoy all that Charlotte's continued growth has to offer. Don't miss your opportunity to own in an established and evolving Charlotte neighborhood!
